description: Get track metadata by ID. For processing readiness prefer adn_get_processing or adn_wait_for_processing. Playable means a successful transcode/original file exists: track_status_id ready is playable; incomplete is also playable but a required output failed; error/init_error are not playable. Optional outputs may still be pending on a ready track. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_get_track
